verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Netlify offers AI-related integrations (connecting AI assistants to Netlify, prompting AI agents from the dashboard) but this describes Netlify being used BY AI assistants/agents, not Netlify itself acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence describes Netlify importing or consuming MCP servers' tools. Missing for 10: any documentation of Netlify functioning as an MCP client, a settings UI for adding MCP server endpoints, or examples of Netlify consuming third-party MCP tool servers.
